title: Cosmic Trio of Cats
description: Three cats sit side by side on a rocky ledge: a long-haired grey cat on the left, a sleek black cat in the center, and an orange tabby cat on the right wearing a colorful cosmic pattern. They are set against a dramatic swirling galaxy sky filled with lightning, stars, colorful nebulae, and glowing orbs.
prompt: Three cats perched on a rocky outcrop under a dramatic cosmic sky, a fluffy grey cat on the left raising a paw, a glossy black cat in the middle with glowing green eyes, and a striped orange tabby on the right wearing a vibrant galaxy-patterned scarf. Swirling purple storm clouds with lightning, colorful nebulae, glowing orbs and shooting stars fill the vibrant night sky, fantasy digital painting style with rich luminous colors
